evals.name: direct-handoff-with-dirty-repos
evals.expected_output: Skill should detect uncommitted changes in repos touched this session, abort with a 'Handoff aborted' message listing the dirty files, and NOT tell the user to type /clear.

evals.name: natural-language-handoff-with-dirty-repos
evals.prompt: Context is getting too big — let's clear and start fresh.
evals.expected_output: Same as #1 — Step 0 must trigger before any 'tell user to /clear' message when the filesystem has uncommitted changes in touched repos.

evals.name: handoff-quality-ephemeral-and-partial-fix
evals.prompt:
/o9k-handoff

[Test scenario — assume this session's history: working on project P0099. This session you (a) found a perf regression and dumped profiling output to /tmp/prof-run.txt, (b) applied a partial fix on branch perf-fix that handles the warm-cache case but NOT the cold-cache path, committed as abc1234, (c) all repos you touched are committed/clean. Produce the o9k-handoff output, especially the Step 2 Next Steps handoff.]
evals.expected_output: Step 0 passes (clean repos). The Step 2 Next Steps handoff (1) gives a verify command for the claim (e.g. 'verify with: git log --oneline main..perf-fix' showing abc1234), (2) flags /tmp/prof-run.txt as ephemeral with a regen note OR mirrors its essence into hmem rather than citing it as permanent, (3) explicitly names the cold-cache path as NOT yet fixed. Then Step 3 tells the user to /clear.

assertions.text: Handoff frames the done-claim as verifiable (includes a git/test/file-check command to confirm it), not a bare assertion
The /tmp/prof-run.txt reference is marked non-durable (ephemeral/cleaned) with a regen path, or its essence is mirrored into hmem — not cited as if permanent
The unfinished cold-cache path is named explicitly as a residual NOT-done gap
Does not instruct /clear until after the Step 2 handoff is complete
